headline: The craft behind the cut. The thinking behind the performance.
intro: I bring editing, motion design, VFX and AI into one post-production process — built around the hook, the pacing and the reason to keep watching.

statistics.label: Views in one month
statistics.detail: From 2.5K views, following in-house content I scripted, shot, rendered and edited.

statistics.label: Viewership growth
statistics.detail: Training the team to script and edit around audience behaviour.

statistics.label: Growth in monthly views
statistics.detail: The increase from 2.5K to 5.2M views in one month.

statistics.label: Team managed
statistics.detail: Setting priorities, training editors and maintaining quality across the team.

statistics.label: Post-production budgets
statistics.detail: Overseeing efficient use of budgets across projects of very different scales.

stories.title: A content approach that found its audience.
stories.text: I scripted, shot, rendered and edited in-house content, built the explainer format and visual identity, and led 3D marketing campaigns. Competition and audience research informed the creative direction.

stories.title: Audience behaviour, built into the edit.
stories.text: I trained teammates to script and edit around social viewing habits, while managing a four-person team across brand, event and film campaigns. The work balanced turnaround, quality and platform fit.

stories.title: Retention is an editorial decision.
stories.text: At BuzzFeed I set edit and visual direction for high-reach YouTube work and guided junior editors. At Creator Engine I shape editorial structure and AI shot priorities, reviewing work against each channel’s retention goals.

selected.title: Highlights
selected.summary: Post-production for films, brands and audiences. Selected work across Netflix, Prime Video, Mumbai Indians and Lollapalooza.

trailers.title: Film
trailers.summary: Trailer and teaser campaigns shaped around story, tension and reveal. Editorial structure, visual treatment and sound work together to earn the next moment.

brands.title: Campaigns
brands.summary: From a brand’s visual identity to the final cut: campaign direction, editing, motion design and 3D, adapted to the platform and the audience.

short-form.title: Short form
short-form.summary: Immediate hooks, controlled pacing and distinctive images. AI-generated shots, compositing and lip-sync extend the ideas that can be made on a short-form schedule.

youtube.title: YouTube
youtube.summary: Editorial structure that carries a viewer from the opening hook to the payoff. Long-form entertainment, interviews and food content, with pacing and visual identity built for the channel.

events.title: Live & comedy
events.summary: Comedy that keeps its timing. Festival and stand-up work that preserves the performance, builds anticipation and carries the energy into the campaign.

source: Prantik_Dutta_Creative_Producer_Resume (2).pdf, supplied September 2026. Viewership figures are career results reported in the résumé; no retention percentage has been inferred.
